policy.name: Kerala Industrial Policy 2023 (incentives operated via K-RIIS; capital subsidy via Entrepreneur Support Scheme (ESS))
policy.order_no: Approved by State Cabinet 29-03-2023 (G.O. number not confirmed)

zones.BACKWARD: Backward districts for ESS top-up (secondary sources: Idukki, Wayanad, Kasaragod, Pathanamthitta) - unverified

zone_lookup: Policy 2023 has no zoning. ESS backward-district list only from secondary sources (official ESS G.O. not retrieved).

schemes.name: Capital subsidy incentive for MSMEs (policy ceiling; delivered via ESS)
schemes.clause: Kerala Industrial Policy 2023, Ch. V Incentives, table item 2 (p.59)
schemes.notes: Policy text: 'upto 45%' - 45% is a MAXIMUM, not the default rate; actual % depends on ESS category/sector/district. Caps: micro Rs 40 lakh, small Rs 100 lakh, medium Rs 200 lakh. Basis per ESS = fixed capital investment. Policy incentives target units in the 22 priority sectors. MSME definition in policy uses old thresholds (P&M <= 1/10/50 cr). Policy text read from copy hosted by GoI Dept of Chemicals (chemindia.chemicals.gov.in); Kerala govt hosts unreachable.
conditions: 45% is the policy maximum; the actual rate is set by the Entrepreneur Support Scheme order

schemes.name: Entrepreneur Support Scheme (ESS) - investment support (as reported)
schemes.clause: ESS (G.O.(MS) No.156/2012/ID dt 28-12-2012 as amended, incl. Ms.No.118/2021/ID) - not retrieved
schemes.notes: SECONDARY ONLY (publicservicesmap / sarkariyojana / youthpower aggregators): general 15% of FCI up to Rs 30 lakh; young (18-45), women, SC/ST, NRK 25% up to Rs 40 lakh; +10% (max Rs 10 lakh) for priority sector; +10% (max Rs 10 lakh) in backward districts (Idukki, Wayanad, Kasaragod, Pathanamthitta); overall cap Rs 40 lakh; released in stages (start-up support, investment support, technology support). Conflicts with Policy 2023 caps (small Rs 1 cr, medium Rs 2 cr) - ESS may have been revised; confirm with ESS G.O. on keralaindustry.org / ess.industry.kerala.gov.in.

schemes.name: Low interest loans for MSMEs (interest subvention)
schemes.clause: Kerala Industrial Policy 2023, Ch. V table item 1
schemes.notes: Loan at 4% interest, maximum loan Rs 10 lakh, via interest subvention up to 6%. Loan size cap Rs 10 lakh (so subvention <= Rs 60,000/yr); tenure not stated in policy. Implementing scheme (likely KSIDC/KFC) not retrieved.

schemes.name: Electricity Duty Exemption for MSMEs
schemes.clause: Kerala Industrial Policy 2023, Ch. V table item 3
schemes.notes: 100% exemption for 5 years. Enabling notification under Kerala Electricity Duty Act not retrieved.

schemes.name: Quality certification incentive
schemes.clause: Kerala Industrial Policy 2023, Ch. V table item 12
schemes.notes: Refund of 50% of expenses for compulsory marking such as CE, FDA, ISO, BIS; max Rs 25 lakh per unit per annum. All categories.

schemes.name: Incentives for sustainability and responsible industrialisation
schemes.clause: Kerala Industrial Policy 2023, Ch. V table item 13
schemes.notes: 25% of P&M/equipment for ETP, grid-power substitution (e.g. solar), rainwater harvesting, ZLD, e-waste/wastewater recycling, energy & water audits; excludes civil works; max Rs 25 lakh during policy period.

other_benefits: Stamp duty & registration: up to 100% waiver on lease/purchase in Government and notified private industrial parks; anywhere in State for women, SC/ST, PH, transgender (item 8).
IPO on SME platform: 50% of expenses up to Rs 1 crore (item 4).
Trade fair participation: up to 100% of stall charges, max Rs 5 lakh (item 10).
IR 4.0: 20% of software/machinery cost up to Rs 25 lakh per unit (item 14).
R&D with Kerala universities: 20% up to Rs 1 crore (item 15).
Made in Kerala certification: 50% of cost (item 17).
PLI top-up: 20% of FCI up to Rs 1 crore for central PLI-shortlisted investors (item 18).
Net SGST reimbursement and 10% investment subsidy are for Large/Mega only (items 5-6), not MSMEs.
unverifiable: All Kerala government hosts (keralaindustry.org, industry.kerala.gov.in, ess/kriis portals) unreachable from this environment; ESS G.O. and implementing orders not read.

Policy tenure is open-ended ('constantly evolving'). Kerala held Assembly elections in 2026 (Governor's policy address May 2026); no successor industrial policy found as of 17-Oct-2026 - only add-on Export Promotion / Logistics / ESG policies (news, UNI) - but re-check.
No power tariff per-unit subsidy found for MSMEs.
curation: kl-ip2023-interest: loan is capped at Rs 10 lakh, so 6% is at most Rs 60,000 a year
